mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.config_batch_operation (audit_tenant_id, operation_id, request_identity_hash, operation_kind, targets_json, response_metadata_json) VALUES (#{auditTenantId}, #{operationId}, #{requestIdentityHash}, #{operationKind}, #{targetsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{responseMetadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (request_identity_hash) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO batch.config_batch_target_receipt (audit_tenant_id, operation_id, target_ordinal, tenant_id, result_json) VALUES (#{auditTenantId}, #{operationId}, #{targetOrdinal}, #{tenantId}, #{resultJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb)
